blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A frontier language model was recently reported to solve 1D NMR structural elucidation without tools. We ask whether this capability transfers to tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) in the de novo setting, where the model must propose a structure directly from the spectrum without a candidate list or reference library. To separate reasoning from recall, we build a 100-analyte benchmark from MassSpecGym, split by each analyte's textual footprint into in-distribution (well documented in literature) and out-of-distribution (essentially undocumented) arms. We hold the model, harness, and output format fixed and vary only the LLM's access to domain-specific tools. Without tools, a frontier LLM reaches 52% Top-1 accuracy in-distribution but only 2% out-of-distribution. Only access to de novo structure generators improves out-of-distribution accuracy, raising it to as much as 38% Top-1, and the resulting agent outperforms the standalone de novo models both in and out of distribution. These results suggest that LLMs are not effective at de novo MS/MS structural elucidation on their own, and that further gains depend on the specialist tools available to the agent rather than on the LLM itself.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) is the dominant approach for identifying unknown small molecules in complex mixtures. Its sensitivity extends to trace quantities that are inaccessible to nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy [ 13 , 30 ] . MS/MS takes an ionized precursor compound and breaks it into fragments, each of which contains a mass and an intensity. Inferring a compound’s identity from its spectrum, a process called structural elucidation , is a central problem in the field of mass spectrometry. This task remains largely unsolved, with most spectra detected in a sample never assigned to a structure. These spectra are known colloquially as the
“dark matter” of metabolomics [ 26 ] .
blocks.zh:
Tandem质谱法(MS/MS)是识别复杂混合物中未知小分子的主导方法. 其灵敏度延伸到核磁共振光谱[13,30]无法取取的微量. MS/MS取出离子化先质化合物并分解成片段,每个片段包含质量和强度. 从一个化合物的光谱中推断其特性,一个叫做结构解析的过程,是质谱学领域的中心问题. 这项任务基本上仍未解决,在样本中检测到的大多数光谱从未分配给一个结构. 这些光谱被称为:
“暗物质”的元组学 [26].

blocks.en:
The standard method for structural elucidation is library matching , which compares a query spectrum against a library of experimentally measured reference spectra and ranks the candidate identities by fragmentation-pattern similarity [ 19 ] . The coverage of library matching is bounded by the size of its spectral libraries, which typically contain 10 4 10^{4} – 10 5 10^{5} distinct structures [ 5 ] , orders of magnitude fewer than the ∼ 10 8 {\sim}10^{8} compounds cataloged in PubChem [ 17 , 7 ] . Furthermore, library-based approaches cannot identify a compound that has never been measured, a category that includes many novel drug metabolites and environmental transformation products. Identifying these compounds requires a class of structural elucidation named de novo generation . De novo elucidation, a form of inverse structural elucidation , generates a candidate structure directly from an MS/MS spectrum, and is the most challenging formulation of structural elucidation. On MassSpecGym, the community-accepted benchmark for this task,
the state-of-the-art de novo Top-1 accuracy is 23.9% [ 3 , 38 ] .
blocks.zh:
结构解析的标准方法是图书库相匹配 将查询频谱与实验测量的参考光谱的图书库相比较,并以分解-平面相近性排列候选身份 [19]. 图书馆相配的覆盖范围由它的光谱库的大小所决定,光谱库通常包含10个4个10^{4}-10个5个10^{5}不同的结构 [5],数量级比在PubChem上被分类的 10个8个'10^{8}化合物 [17,7]. 此外,基于图书馆的方法无法确定从未被测量过的化合物,这一类别包括许多新的药物代谢物和环境转化产品。 确定这些化合物需要一类结构说明, 重新阐释是一种反向结构阐释形式,直接从MS/MS频谱产生一个候选结构,是结构阐释的最有挑战性的表述. 关于MassSpecGym,社区接受的这项任务基准,
最新水平的德诺沃一号精度为23.9% [3,38].

blocks.en:
Recent work reports strong zero-shot performance of frontier LLMs on the inverse elucidation problem in NMR spectroscopy. In Making Claude a Chemist [ 15 ] ,
Claude Opus 4.7 was given fifteen 1D inverse elucidation problems,
each supplying 1 H and 13 C peak lists, molecular formulae,
and, for the seven hardest spectra, the reaction’s starting material. With no tools and no chemistry-specific fine-tuning, a setting that mirrors de novo elucidation, it returned the published structure on at least two of three attempts for every compound.
Because the compounds were taken from preprints posted after the model’s training cutoff,
the result cannot be attributed to memorization.
blocks.zh:
最近的工作报告说,前沿有限责任公司在NMR光谱学中的反向说明问题上表现强劲。 让克洛德成为化学家
Claude Opus 4.7被给了15个1D反向解释问题,
提供1H和13C峰值列表,分子式,
并且,对于7个最难的光谱,反应的起步材料. 它没有工具,也没有化学特有的微调,一个反射出新解释的设定,它至少将每种化合物的三次尝试中的两次还原了公布的结构。
由于这些化合物取自模型训练停产后张贴的预印本,
结果不能归结于记忆。

blocks.en: This work asks whether the zero-shot structural elucidation performance reported for Claude Opus on NMR [ 15 ] translates to MS/MS. This translation is not guaranteed, as chemical shift in NMR reflects each nucleus’s local environment and is approximately additive, making the substructure-to-shift mapping compositional [ 28 ] . By contrast, MS/MS fragmentation is stochastic and non-local, proceeding through charge migration, rearrangement, and competing dissociation channels [ 13 ] , so fragments vary with adduct and instrument [ 33 , 5 ] . Unlike NMR shifts, MS/MS spectra therefore cannot be reliably predicted, or inverted, from substructure rules alone.
blocks.zh: 这部作品问道,为克洛德·奥普斯(Claude Opus)报道的NMR[15]的零镜头结构解析性能是否被翻译为MS/MS. 这种翻译是不能保证的,因为NMR中的化学改变反映了每个核糖体的局部环境,并且大约是添加剂,使得亚结构到相变的绘图组成[28]. 相比之下,MS/MS的分化是有条理的和非局部的,通过电荷迁移、重排和相竞争的分解渠道[13]进行,因此片段随取法和仪器[33,5]而异. 与NMR的变相不同,MS/MS光谱因此单从子结构规则无法可靠地预测或倒置.

blocks.en: We additionally explore whether an LLM with tools, an agent, can improve de novo elucidation performance. In other chemistry domains, tools cover capabilities that a base model lacks [ 23 , 4 ] , but the benefit is task-dependent and can be negative for competent LLMs [ 37 ] . No equivalent attribution exists for MS/MS, where published comparisons of agents with and without tools reduce to a single all-or-nothing contrast between the full toolbox and none of it [ 34 ] . Furthermore, without a careful ablation of the tools used in an agent, it is challenging to determine whether an agent came to an answer via reasoning over its tool outputs, or memorization (recall) over its training data.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步探索一个具有工具的LLM,一个代理,能否提高重新澄清的性能. 在其他化学领域,工具涵盖一个基础模型缺乏的能力[23,4],但好处取决于任务,对胜任的LLMs[37]可能是负面的. MS/MS没有对应的归属,其中公布的与工具或没有工具的代理人的比较,在完整的工具箱和没有工具的工具箱之间缩小为单一的一无所有或一无所有对比[34]. 此外,如果不仔细考虑代理人使用的工具,就很难确定代理人是对其工具产出进行推理,还是对其培训数据进行记念(回顾)。

blocks.en:
Contributions. To evaluate the de novo MS/MS elucidation capabilities of agentic LLMs, we contribute the following.
(a) We construct a 100-spectrum MS/MS benchmark from the MassSpecGym test fold. This benchmark contains two sets of spectra matched on acquisition conditions but with a different literature footprint,
separating memorization from reasoning-based elucidation.
(b) We show that, without tools, the LLM’s accuracy tracks a compound’s literature footprint rather than the information in its spectrum. It reaches 52% Top-1 accuracy on well-documented in-distribution (ID) compounds but only 2% on out-of-distribution (OOD) compounds.
(c) We attribute performance to individual tools by ablation under a fixed harness,
finding that subformula annotation and forward prediction only improve performance on in-distribution analytes,
while a de novo generator raises out-of-distribution accuracy to 12–38%.
(d) We show that this out-of-distribution gain is bounded by the candidates the generator proposes, with the LLM acting as a better re-ranker.

(a) 国家 我们从MassSpecGym测试折叠中构建出100分光谱的MS/MS基准. 这个基准包含两组光谱 匹配的获取条件 但有不同的文献足迹,

(b) 国家 我们显示,没有工具,LLM的精确度会跟踪一个化合物的文献足迹,而不是其光谱中的信息. 它在有据可查的内分泌(ID)化合物上达到52%的Top-1精度,但在外分泌(OOD)化合物上只有2%.
(c) 将性能归结为个人工具,方法是在固定的管子下消化,
发现子窗体注释和前向预测只会改善分解分析的性能,
新的生成器将分配率提高至12-38%。
(d) 国家 我们显示,这种分配之外的收益是由生成者提出的候选人所决定的,LLM是更好的重新排名者。

Data. All spectra were selected from the test fold (17,556 spectra) of MassSpecGym v1.5 [ 22 ] ,

Structures are standardized with the pipeline of Gupta et al. [12] ,
which strips stereochemistry, neutralizes charges, and canonicalizes tautomers,
yielding 2,992 unique test-fold analytes (Appendix B ).
Unique molecular identity is defined by the 14-character InChIKey connectivity block, because MS/MS alone cannot resolve stereoisomers.

blocks.en: Benchmark Creation. This work seeks to compare in-distribution versus out-of-distribution performance of LLMs on structural elucidation. However, frontier models rarely disclose their training data, making it difficult to determine whether they have encountered a given compound. We therefore use a molecule’s textual footprint , defined as the number of PubMed records linked to the compound in PubChem [ 18 ] , as a proxy for whether an analyte exists in an LLM’s training data. The intuition behind this choice is that frontier models are extensively trained on scientific literature, and compounds that are more prevalent in literature are more likely to exist in an LLM’s training dataset, thus becoming in-distribution. Our benchmark is split into two arms (Figure 1 , Appendix Table 2 ). The textually out-of-distribution (OOD) arm selects analytes with zero linked PubMed records, no Medical Subject Headings (MeSH) entry, and a systematic (IUPAC) PubChem title, whereas the textually in-distribution (ID) arm selects analytes with at least 100 linked PubMed records, a MeSH entry, and a common-name title. Note that, given our benchmark setup, “OOD” here refers to the textual distribution alone and does not imply chemical novelty.
blocks.zh: 基准创建。 这项工作力求将有限责任方案在结构解释方面的分配与分配外业绩进行比较。 然而,前沿模型很少披露其培训数据,因此难以确定是否遇到特定化合物。 因此,我们使用一个分子的文字足迹(被定义为PubMed记录与PubChem [18] 中的化合物相连接的数量)作为LLM训练数据中是否存在分析物的代名词. 这一选择背后的直觉是,前沿模型在科学文献方面得到了广泛的培训,在文献中更为流行的化合物在LLM的训练数据集中更可能存在,从而成为分流. 我们的基准分为两个武器(图1,附录表2)。 文本外分配 (OOD) 臂选择无链接的 PubMed 记录分析, 无医学主题标题( MeSH) 条目, 以及系统化( IUPAC) PubChem 标题,而文本在分配(ID)臂中选择至少100个链接到的PubMed记录,一个MESH条目,和一个通名标题. 请注意,鉴于我们的基准设置,此处的“OOD”仅指文字分布,并不意味着化学新意。

blocks.en:
In order to isolate training distribution as our independent variable, we control for “spectral difficulty” in selecting our benchmark analytes. We randomly select 50 OOD analytes from our candidate set and pair them to the closest unused ID analyte by precursor m / z m/z , fragment-peak count, adduct, and instrument.
Each analyte contributes one spectrum, so in this text we use “analyte” and “spectrum” interchangeably. The 100 analytes were fixed before any experiment was run (see Appendix B for details).
blocks.zh:
为了将培训分布作为独立的变量加以隔离,我们在选择基准分析时控制“光谱困难”。 我们随机从我们的候选人组中选择50个OOD分析结果, 并用m / z m/z、碎片-峰值计数、取出和仪器将它们配对到最接近未使用的ID分析结果。
每种分析都提供一种范围,因此,在本案文中,我们可互换使用“分析”和“光谱”。 100个分析仪在进行任何实验之前就已经固定(详情见附录B)。

blocks.en: Task and Metrics. All experiments use the same task. Given the ( m/z , intensity ) peaks of an MS/MS spectrum, the precursor m/z , and the precursor’s neutral molecular formula, identify the precursor molecule, returning k = 5 k=5 ranked candidate structures as SMILES. We evaluate performance using Top-1 and Top-5 accuracy, where a prediction is counted as correct if the 2D InChIKey of any of the Top- k k generated molecules matches that of the ground-truth precursor. The 2D InChIKey is the first 14-character block of the full InChIKey, and encodes molecular connectivity but not stereochemistry. We additionally measure molecular similarity of generated molecules against their ground truth via Tanimoto@1 over 2048-bit ECFP4 fingerprints and MCES@1, a graph edit distance.
blocks.zh: 任务和计量。 所有实验都使用同样的任务. 考虑到MS/MS频谱的(m/z,强度)峰值,前体m/z,和前体的中性分子式,识别出前体分子,还原k=5克=5级候选结构为SMILES. 我们使用Top-1和Top-5的精度来评价性能,如果Top-k k生成的分子中的2D InChiKey与地真前体相匹配,则该预测被计算为正确. 2D InChiKey是全取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取 我们通过Tanimoto@1,通过2048-bit ECFP4指纹和MCES@1对生成的分子的分子相似性进行测量,这是图编辑距离。

blocks.en:
Harness. In order to adequately assess tool contribution to structural elucidation, the agent harness is fixed for all experiments and only the tool set varies. Query spectra, model, output contract, parser, scorer, sampling parameters, and turn budget are identical across experiments.
All experiments run Claude Opus 5 at high reasoning effort with a
64,000-token output allowance and a ceiling of twenty tool calls per query.
Every tool run shares one system prompt and differs only in the attached tool definitions,
so differences among them are attributable to the tools alone.
The LLM baseline experiment uses a modified prompt which omits tool descriptions. Each analyte is elucidated with fresh context, and all tool outputs are screened to ensure no ground-truth annotations were leaked to the agent.
Analytes are re-run under the same configuration until every experiment reports 100 usable answers (Appendix C ).

因此,它们之间的差别只能归因于工具。
LLM基线实验使用一个被修改的快取来省去工具描述. 每个分析都有新的上下文,并筛选出所有工具产出,以确保不向代理人泄露任何地面真实说明。

blocks.en:
Tools. Three tools are available to the agent: subformula annotation returns a subformula for every peak in an MS/MS spectrum that is consistent with the parent formula, forward prediction simulates an MS/MS spectrum from a SMILES string,
and de novo generation attempts to identify structures directly from the spectrum, returning a list of candidate SMILES. Subformula annotation and forward prediction let an agent test candidate identities. De novo generators instead propose those identities, shifting the agent’s work from generating candidates to evaluating them. These tools are provided to the agent via two interchangeable tool suites. The public suite uses MIST-CF’s subformula annotation script [ 10 ] for subformula annotation, GLACIER [ 32 ] for forward prediction, and MS-GPT [ 38 ] and FRIGID [ 3 ] for de novo generation. As of the time of experimentation (August 2026), MS-GPT and FRIGID are the current and previous state-of-the-art de novo identification models on the MassSpecGym benchmark. The in-house suite substitutes proprietary models for subformula annotation and de novo generation while retaining GLACIER. We denote our in-house generator LSM-Gen , a de novo model from our LSM (Large Spectral Model) family [ 1 ] , retrained for this paper.

工具 来 代理有三种工具: 子公式注释返回一个子公式,用于一个MS/MS频谱中符合母公式的每个峰值,前向预测从一个SMILES字符串模拟一个MS/MS频谱,
并再次试图从谱系中直接确定结构,退回候选SMILES名单。 子公式注释和前向预测让一个代理测试候选身份. 将代理商的工作从产生候选人转向评价候选人。 这些工具通过两个可互换的工具套件提供给代理商. 公共套房使用MIST-CF的子公式注释脚本[10]用于子公式注释,GLACIER [32]用于前向预测,而MS-GPT [38]和FRIGID [3]用于再生. 截至实验时(2026年8月),MS-GPT和FRIGID是MassSpecGym基准上目前和之前最先进的新识别模型. 在保留GLACIER的同时,内部套房中用于子窗体注释和再生成的专有模型. 我们表示我们的内部发电机LSM-Gen, 一个来自我们的LSM(大光谱模型)家族的新模型 [1], 为本文重新训练。

blocks.en: All three generators use spectrum encoders trained on the same spectra (FRIGID and MS-GPT share a single MIST checkpoint; Appendix F ), but their decoders are trained on different molecular datasets. FRIGID and MS-GPT pretrain their decoders on 100M–230M structures from the SAFE-GPT molecule collection [ 25 ] , excluding test structures only by exact 2D InChIKey match [ 22 ] . LSM-Gen instead uses a stricter split, the smaller 50M-structure leakage-reduced dataset of Liu et al. [22] , which also removes any molecule with ECFP4 Tanimoto similarity ≥ 0.7 \geq 0.7 to a test structure (Appendix E ).
blocks.zh: 所有三台发电机都使用同一光谱所训练的频谱编码器(FRIGID和MS-GPT共用一个MIST检查点;附录F),但其解码器则接受不同分子数据集的培训. FRIGID和MS-GPT在从SAFE-GPT分子收集的100M–230M结构上预排解码器[25],仅通过精确的2D InChiKey匹配来排除测试结构[22]. LSM-Gen取而代之的是更严格的分出,更小的50M结构出漏的刘等的数据集. [22],它也去除任何与ECFP4 田本相近的分子 ^ 0.7\geq 0.7到测试结构 (附录 E.).

blocks.en: Experiments. Experiments are cumulative, each adding one tool at a time. L0 is the LLM-only baseline. Given that no tools are used for this experiment, whatever performance it achieves comes only from pattern recognition, chain-of-thought reasoning, and memorization. L1 adds subformula annotation, removing peak assignment from the model’s own arithmetic. L2 adds forward prediction, used to test candidate structures once they are predicted. L3 adds de novo generation, which provides the agent with a set of candidate structures that it can then test. At L3 the generated structures are added to the agent’s candidate set, not swapped in for it. Each generator model is also run standalone as a non-agentic baseline.

blocks.en: Tools help and de novo generators enable OOD. Subformula annotation (L1) and forward prediction (L2) improve ID Top-1 accuracy from 52% at L0 to 62% and 56% respectively, but leave OOD unchanged at 2%. Adding a de novo generator raises OOD Top-1 to 12% with FRIGID, 26% with MS-GPT, and 38% with LSM-Gen , lifting performance across all 100 analytes to 40%, 56%, and 59% respectively. The two hypothesis-testing tools, forward prediction and subformula annotation, contribute only toward identifying ID analytes, whereas the tools that propose candidate structures enable OOD hits. Forward prediction is also mildly counterproductive where it does act, costing six points of ID Top-1 in L2 relative to L1. Across all experiments, at most 14% of errors occur in cases where the agent had the correct structure but failed to return it first. In nearly all of the remainder, the structure was never proposed by the agent or its tools (Appendix Figure 6 ). This finding suggests that the generation of plausible chemical structures, rather than the ranking of candidates once proposed, is the primary bottleneck of agentic reasoning in de novo MS/MS elucidation.

blocks.en: 4 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 4. 讨论和限制

blocks.en: Our work shows that, without tools, a frontier model’s MS/MS de novo identification accuracy tracks how much has been written about a compound rather than what its spectrum contains. This shortcoming can be addressed by giving an agent a de novo generator tool, over whose candidates an agent is an effective re-ranker. The approach presented here is not without limitations, which we outline below.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究表明,没有工具,前沿模型的MS/MS de novo识别精度跟踪记录了有关一个化合物的写作量,而不是它的光谱。 可以通过向代理人提供重新生成工具来解决这一缺陷,其候选人的代理人是有效的重新排名者。 这里介绍的方法并非没有限制,我们概述如下。

blocks.en: Re-ranking improves elucidation accuracy on the hardest spectra, those that require de novo identification, but at roughly twenty times the cost of the generator alone (Appendix D ). Samples may hold thousands of MS/MS spectra, so on its own the agent studied here is prohibitively expensive for untargeted metabolomics workflows. We suggest that a practical agent would instead resolve most spectra by library matching and in-silico retrieval, pass most of the remainder to the generator alone, and reserve the de novo elucidation workflow studied here for the few spectra that matter most.
blocks.zh: 重排提高了最困难光谱的清晰度,即那些需要重新识别的光谱,但仅发电机的成本大约为20倍(附录D.). 样本可能持有上千个MS/MS光谱,因此在这里研究的特效对于没有目标的元组学工作流程来说过于昂贵. 我们建议,一个实用的代理将解决大多数光谱,通过库比对和内硅酸酯检索,将其余大部分单独传递给生成器,并将在这里研究的重新解析的工作流程保留给少数最重要的光谱.

blocks.en: The difference in ID/OOD performance is not unique to the LLM, which limits what these experiments can attribute to it. In the LLM baseline experiment, Top-1 accuracy falls from 52% on ID analytes to 2% on OOD, a factor of 26. However, the performance of all three generator-only runs falls as well, though by a much smaller factor of roughly two to four (24% to 6% for FRIGID, 48% to 18% for MS-GPT, and 60% to 32% for LSM-Gen ). One explanation is that ID analytes have closer structural analogues in the generators’ encoder training data. All three de novo models condition on encoders trained with the same PubChem-derived dataset of synthetic spectra, from which test structures are removed by exact InChIKey match only, leaving close analogues in place. Nearest-neighbor similarity of test-set analytes to that dataset splits by benchmark arm (ECFP4 Tanimoto median 0.90 ID against 0.82 OOD, Appendix F ). Future work should therefore remove close analogues from the encoder’s training data, not just exact matches. Importantly, this is not direct leakage since the synthetic spectra in the encoder’s training dataset are simulated by a forward model trained only on MassSpecGym’s training split, so the models never see an experimental spectrum of any test compound.
blocks.zh: ID/OOD性能的差异并非LLM所独有的,它限制了这些实验能够归属于它的东西. 在LLM基线实验中,Top-1精度从ID分析仪上的52%下降到OOD上的2%,系数为26. 然而,所有三台仅限发电机运行的性能也下降了,但下降幅度要小得多,大约为2至4个(FRIGID为24%至6%,MS-GPT为48%至18%,LSM-Gen为60%至32%)。 一种解释是,ID分析在发电机编码器培训数据中有更紧密的结构模拟。 所有三个de novo模型条件都以同一PubChem衍生的合成光谱数据集所训练的编码器为条件,从中测试结构仅由精确的InChiKey匹配来去除,留下了相近的模拟. 试验组分析仪与该数据集最近近的相似性,按基准臂划分(ECFP4 Tanimoto中值为0.90 ID而OD,附录F.0.82)。 因此,今后的工作应当从编码器的培训数据中去除近似数据,而不仅仅是精确的匹配数据。 重要的是,这不是直接渗出,因为编码器的训练数据集中的合成光谱是由只受过MassSpecGym训练分解训练的先行模型所模拟的,因此这些模型从未看到任何试验化合物的实验光谱.

blocks.en: Our results carry further limitations. Firstly, textual footprint is a proxy for out-of-distribution which we cannot verify without observing the LLM’s training datasets. Training datasets of frontier models are undisclosed and these analytes do exist in PubChem, so a compound with no literature record may still have been seen. Secondly, other forms of MS/MS leakage in the LLM may exist. In Appendix G , we observe a significant improvement in performance on analytes whose PubChem pages contain MS/MS spectra. Thirdly, we evaluate a single model at a single date, without sweeping providers, temperatures, or token budgets. Finally, Opus 5 is not uniformly the strongest LLM on scientific tasks [ 20 ] , so the experiment’s absolute numbers should be read as one configuration rather than a frontier.
blocks.zh: 我们的成果还有进一步的限制。 首先,文字足迹是分散分发的代名词,如果不观察LLM的训练数据集,我们就无法核实。 边疆模型的训练数据集是不公开的,这些分析数据确实存在于PubChem,因此一个没有文献记录的复合体可能仍然被看到. 第二,LLM中可能存在其他形式的MS/MS渗出. 在附录G中,我们观察到在分析器上的性能有了显著的改善,其PubChem的页面含有MS/MS光谱. 第三,我们在一个单一的日期评估一个单一的模型,没有覆盖供应商、温度或象征性预算。 最后,Opus 5并不是在科学任务上一致地最强的LLM[20],因此实验的绝对数应该被解读为一个配置而不是边框.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Unlike in NMR, a frontier model alone cannot perform de novo structural elucidation of tandem mass spectra. Opus 5 zero-shot identifies 27% of our benchmark spectra, but these are almost exclusively well-cited compounds, and Top-1 accuracy falls from 52% to 2% between in- and out-of-distribution analytes. When integrated with specialist tools in an agentic framework, an LLM outperforms state-of-the-art de novo generator models both in and out of distribution, although its out-of-distribution performance remains limited by the candidates its de novo generator provides. Future efforts to annotate a larger share of the dark matter of metabolomics will therefore require both better de novo models and more sophisticated agents that draw on a wider range of structural elucidation tools.
blocks.zh: 与NMR不同的是,单凭边疆模型无法重新对并发质谱进行结构解释。 Opus 5 零发射识别了我们基准光谱的27%,但这些几乎都是被完全引用的化合物,Top-1的精度从52%下降到了分配中和分配外分析中的2%. 如果在代理框架内与专家工具相结合,LLM在分配过程中和分配过程中都超越了最先进的新发电机模型,尽管其分配外的性能仍然受到候选人的限制。 因此,今后要说明更多元件组的暗物质,既需要更好的新模型,也需要利用更广泛的结构说明工具的更先进的物剂。

blocks.en: Routine annotation matches an observed spectrum against reference libraries by cosine, modified-cosine, or spectral-entropy similarity, and is therefore restricted to compounds a library already contains. Structural retrieval relaxes this constraint by matching predicted fingerprints [ 10 , 8 ] or through in-silico spectra [ 31 , 33 , 32 ] to structure databases like PubChem. Both approaches assume that the structure of interest already exists in some library or database, which is an assumption that does not hold for novel or uncharacterized analytes.
blocks.zh: 常规注解与所观测到的光谱相匹配,取自同位素、经修改的同位素或光谱同位素相类似,因此仅限于已包含的化合物。 结构检索通过将预测的指纹[10,8]相匹配,或通过内-硅化光谱[31,33,32]来将PubChem等数据库结构化来放松这一制约. 这两种方法都假设,一些图书馆或数据库中已经存在利益结构,而这种假设对于新颖的或无特征的解析方法来说是站不住脚的.

blocks.en: De novo structural elucidation methods overcome the limitations of library matching by generating a structure directly from the spectrum. Early fingerprint-to-structure decoders [ 29 ] were followed by formula-conditioned generative models, including diffusion over molecular graphs and sequences [ 3 ] . Current state-of-the-art public models score roughly 24% Top-1 accuracy on chemically OOD test sets [ 38 ] . In order to read our results against the state-of-the-art, we used the top two de novo models available at the time of experimentation in August 2026.
blocks.zh: 重新解析结构的方法通过直接从频谱生成一个结构来克服库匹配的局限性. 早期的指纹到结构解码器[29]之后是配方条件的基因模型,包括分子图和序列的传播[3]. 目前最先进的公共模型在化学OOD测试集上得分约为24%的Top-1精度[38]. 为了对照最先进的水平阅读我们的结果,我们使用了2026年8月实验时可用的前两个德新模型.

blocks.en: Off-the-shelf LLMs have previously been observed to fail outright at direct spectra-to-structure prediction: prompted with chain-of-thought on MassSpecGym, four LLMs return no exact match at Top-10 accuracy, against 4.25% for a spectrum-trained diffusion baseline [ 35 ] . Agentic framings have been more productive. The GNPS2 framework couples an LLM to tools for MS/MS alignment, formula decomposition, structural enumeration, substructure mapping, spectral prediction, and validation against mass, adduct, and retention time; it recovered several previously unannotated metabolites, later confirmed experimentally [ 34 ] . MSAgent orchestrates an LLM with more than fifty domain-specific tools, reporting MRR gains above 10 % 10\% on CASMI retrieval and roughly 40 % 40\% mean Tanimoto improvement when refining de novo outputs on CANOPUS, both against a tool-free GPT-4o arm [ 21 ] . MS4MS pairs a fine-tuned domain model with a formula agent and an identification agent that cosine-matches spectral libraries and reasons over the retrieved neighbors, reporting 92.0 % 92.0\% Top-1 formula accuracy on the same MassSpecGym test fold used here [ 11 ] . MetaboT routes an LLM over a metabolomics knowledge graph through entity resolution, schema-aware SPARQL generation, and query refinement, reporting 83.7 % 83.7\% accuracy on forty-nine expert-authored questions against 8.2 % 8.2\% for single-shot GPT-4o [ 2 ] . MetaboAnnotate uses a multi-agent setup which predicts molecule identities using consensus voting over three orthogonal forward prediction (in-silico fragment generation) tools, reporting 36.5 % 36.5\% and 28.2 % 28.2\% Top-1 retrieval on CASMI 2016 and 2022 respectively [ 39 ] . Three limits follow from these existing agents. First, each agent couples retrieval or database lookup to whatever generative capability it has and reports a single identification number over the combination, so none isolates de novo generation performance. Second, each is evaluated in a tool-maximal configuration, compared either against an external baseline or against the same model stripped of every tool at once. Therefore, the marginal contribution of any one component cannot be measured. Third, every tool-free arm in this literature, including the chain-of-thought benchmark above, runs on GPT-4o, GPT-5 nano, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, or a fine-tuned 14B model, so the systems are not measured using a frontier model.
blocks.zh: 以前观察到在直接光谱到结构的预测中,现成的LLMs完全失败:在MassSpecGym上的思维链被激发,4个LLMs在Top-10的准确度上没有准确的匹配率,而受光谱训练的传播基线为4.25% [35] 。 代理框架更有成效。 GNPS2框架将一个LLM配对成MS/MS配对、公式分解、结构计数、子结构绘图、光谱预测和对质量、分解和保存时间的验证工具;它回收了以前未经说明的几种代谢物,后来经过实验证实[34]。 MSAgent在CANOPUS上重新提炼输出时, 使用超过50个专有域的工具来协调LLM, MS4MS将一个微调的域名模型与一个公式代理和一个识别代理对接,该识别代理在被检索的相邻的相邻区域上,对相邻的相邻光谱库和原因进行相邻,在此处使用的MassSpecGym测试折叠上报告92.0 % 92.0\% Top-1公式精度[11]. [2]。 MetaboAnnotate使用多剂设置,通过对3个正向前向预测(硅相片生成)工具的协商一致表决来预测分子身份,在CASMI 2016和2022上分别报告36.5% 36.5%和28.2% Top-1检索. 这些现有代理人有三个限制。 首先,每对代理夫妇检索或数据库,查看其拥有的任何基因能力,并在组合上报告一个单一的识别号码,因此没有任何一个能隔离出新的生成性能. 第二,对每个工具进行工具-最大配置评价,与外部基线或同一模型同时对每个工具进行对比。 因此,无法衡量任何一个组成部分的边际贡献。 第三,本文献中每个无工具臂,包括上面的思维链基准,都运行在GPT-4o,GPT-5纳米,克洛德-3.5-索内特上,或微调的14B模型上,因此系统没有使用边框模型来测量.

blocks.en: Memorization in LLMs has also been studied directly. The likelihood that a model memorizes a fact grows log-linearly with how often that fact is duplicated in pretraining [ 6 ] , and accuracy on factual questions tracks how many pretraining documents mention both the question and its answer, a dependence that scaling alone is unlikely to remove [ 16 ] . Retrieval augmentation helps most on questions about less popular subjects [ 24 ] . Our agent experiments test this same interaction in a setting where the retrieved object is a molecular structure rather than a fact.

blocks.en: Note that using PubMed citation counts in MS/MS identification has precedent: MetFrag uses PubMed and patent counts to prioritize well-documented candidates [ 27 ] . Unlike MetFrag, however, we use documentation not as a ranking signal but as a proxy for how likely a model is to recall a compound rather than identify it from spectral evidence.

blocks.en: This work interrogates LLM performance on MS/MS structural elucidation across in- and out-of-distribution settings. In order to estimate whether an analyte is in-distribution to a language model’s training dataset, we measure its textual footprint . To measure this footprint, we construct a local snapshot of PubChem using the bulk NCBI distributions for InChIKeys, synonyms, titles, PubMed associations, MeSH terms, patents, and depositor records. Analytes from MassSpecGym are then joined to these PubChem entries via their 2D InChIKey connectivity block (first 14 characters of the InChIKey). 10 out of 2,992 MassSpecGym test-fold analytes cannot be joined because their 2D InChIKey after analyte standardization does not exist in PubChem. Multiple PubChem CIDs may map to one 2D InChIKey, so we measure literature prevalence using the maximum number of linked PubMed records among CIDs sharing the same 2D InChIKey block.
blocks.zh: 这项工作询问了在分配内外各处的MS/MS结构解析方面的LLM性能. 为了估计分析是否传播到语言模型的培训数据集,我们测量其文字足迹。 为了测量这个足迹,我们用大量NCBI的分布来绘制PubChem的当地快照,用于InChiKeys,同义词,标题,PubMed协会,MeSH术语,专利,以及储户记录. MassSpecGym的Analytes随后通过他们的2D InChiKey连接块(InChiKey的前14个字符)加入这些PubChem条目. 2,992个MassSpecGym测试倍数分析中,有10个无法加入,因为其分析后2D InChiKey在PubChem不存在. 多个 PubChem CID 可能映射到一个 2D InChiKey,所以我们用共享同一 2D InChiKey 块的 CID 中连接的 PubMed 记录的最大数量来测量文献的普及性.

blocks.en: We then construct a 100-analyte benchmark containing two sets of 50 analytes (Table 2 ). The textually OOD arm contains compounds with zero linked PubMed records, no MeSH annotation, and a PubChem display title classified as systematic (IUPAC-like), whereas the in-distribution arm requires at least 100 linked PubMed records, a MeSH annotation, and a common-name title. MassSpecGym often holds several spectra for the same analyte, so we only keep the spectrum with the median peak count to ensure (analyte, spectrum) uniqueness. Importantly, “OOD” here refers specifically to the textual distribution : these compounds lack the literature indexing and common names that could give a language model an obvious memorized structure–name association. It does not imply that they are chemically out of distribution for a molecular structure model, or that they are absent from the LLM’s training data altogether.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们构建一个包含两组50个分析仪的100分析基准(表2)。 文字上的OOD臂包含有零链接的PubMed记录的化合物,没有MESH注释,以及被归类为系统化(IUPAC-like)的PubChem显示标题,而分配臂则需要至少100个链接的PubMed记录,一个MESH注释,和一个通名标题. MassSpecGym经常为同一种分析仪持有多个光谱,因此我们只保留与中位峰值计数的光谱,以确保(分析仪,谱)的独特性. 重要的是,“OOD”在此具体提到文字分布:这些化合物缺乏文献索引和通用名称,无法给语言模型一个明显的被记住的结构-名称关联。 这并不意味着它们从化学角度来说是分子结构模型的不分布,或者它们完全没有LLM的训练数据。

blocks.en: Our work leverages three de novo generators, one of which is an in-house model ( LSM-Gen ), whose architecture we do not disclose. We audit the data provenance of all three models.

blocks.en: We adopt the decoder-side leakage standard established by MassSpecGym v1.5 [ 22 ] . Decoders are typically trained on large unlabeled molecular corpora with test compounds excluded only by exact 2D InChIKey match, a criterion that is much weaker than the MCES ≥ 10 \geq 10 separation that defines generalization in MassSpecGym. A decoder may therefore satisfy exact-match decontamination while retaining a dense structural neighborhood around each test compound, and recover targets by local interpolation.
blocks.zh: 我们采用MassSpecGym v1.5[22]确定的解码器-侧渗出标准. 解码器一般在大型无标签分子蝎子上被训练,测试化合物仅被精确的2D InChiKey匹配所排除,这个标准比MCES 10\geq 10分离标准要弱得多,后者在MassSpecGym中定义了通称. 因此,一个解码器可以满足精确匹配的去污,同时在每个试验复合体周围保留一个密集的结构相邻,并通过局部插入来恢复目标.

blocks.en: FRIGID is pretrained on the SAFE-GPT molecule collection of Noutahi et al. [25] with all NPLIB1 and MassSpecGym test and validation structures masked using an exclusion list of connectivity-based (2D) InChIKeys. The authors additionally retain 17% of SAFE-GPT strings that could not be parsed into molecular structures, using all-zero conditioning. These records admit no computable InChIKey and therefore fall outside the exclusion list.
blocks.zh: FRIGID在Noutahi等人的SAFE-GPT分子采集上受到预先训练. [25] 与所有NPLIB1和MassSpecGym测试和验证结构相遮,使用基于连接的排除列表(2D) InChiKeys. 作者还额外保留了17%的SAFE-GPT字符串,这些字符串不能被分解成分子结构,使用全零条件. 这些记录没有计算在内,因此不属于排除名单。

blocks.en: MS-GPT applies an equivalent criterion to its conditional pretraining dataset. From a 117,280,040-record SAFE-GPT subset, 17,220,290 unparseable records are discarded and a further 52,391 excluded based on connectivity-based 2D InChIKeys from the validation and test sets [ 38 , Appendix B.2] . The decoder backbone is warm-started from the public datamol-io/safe-gpt checkpoint trained on the uncurated SAFE-GPT molecule collection, and remains frozen through posterior-aligned adaptation [ 38 , Sections 3.2 and 3.4, Appendix B.1] . The leakage standards presented by MassSpecGym v1.5 therefore only apply to the second of the two training stages for MS-GPT, and this SAFE-GPT warm-start may be a potential source of leakage in this model.
blocks.zh: MS-GPT对其有条件的预训数据集适用了等同的标准. 从117,280,040-记录的SAFE-GPT子集中,17,220,290个无法解析的记录被丢弃,还有52,391个基于基于连接的2D InChiKeys从验证和测试集中排除[38,附录B.2]. 解码器主干线由未校正的SAFE-GPT分子收集训练的公用数据mol-io/secret-gpt检查站温暖地启动,并通过后相适应而保持被冻结[38, 第3.2和3.4节,附录B.1]. 因此,MassSpecGym v1.5提出的渗漏标准只适用于MS-GPT的两个培训阶段中的第二个阶段,而这种SAFE-GPT的温起点可能是本模型中渗漏的潜在来源.

blocks.en: Appendix E audits the datasets on which the three decoders were pretrained. Their encoders share a second potential leakage route addressed here. FRIGID and MS-GPT both condition on fingerprints from the same MIST vFRIGID checkpoint. This checkpoint was trained with synthetic spectra from 457,818 PubChem structures. Drugs, metabolites, and natural products accumulate registered analogues, derivatives, and synthetic intermediates, whereas less documented, systematically titled molecules are more often structurally isolated. A dataset sampled from PubChem inherits that correlation, which may explain why the three generator models also perform better on ID than OOD analytes.

The de novo generators show no difference in performance. FRIGID and LSM-Gen are flat (16% against 14%, 45% against 46%) and MS-GPT is slightly reversed (29% against 35%; Figure 5 ). blocks.en: Despite this finding, this leakage via PubChem may only partially explain why certain analytes were identified zero-shot by the LLM. Within the in-distribution arm, the LLM identifies 72% of analytes with a PubChem MS/MS entry against 32% without ( p = 0.01 p{=}0.01 ). Furthermore, the exposure route of displayed MS/MS spectra on PubChem entries to an LLM’s training dataset is narrow. Each record lists only five peaks, and for 13 of the 31 analytes the MS/MS spectrum is only reachable through a salt or stereoisomer record. We nonetheless report this finding as an additional explanation for the strong zero-shot elucidation performance of LLMs on in-distribution analytes.

blocks.en:
You are an expert mass spectrometrist identifying a structure from a single
tandem mass spectrum. The neutral molecular formula is given. You have a set
of specialist tools; each tool’s own description states what it does, what its
scores mean, and -- importantly -- what it is measurably bad at. Read those
descriptions before you rely on a result.

Work in four steps.

0. **Commit before you consult.** Before you call any tool, write out your own
   ranked candidates from what you already know: given this formula and these
   peaks, what compound is this? Name it if you can. Say plainly when nothing
   comes to mind -- an empty prior is a real answer and pretending otherwise
   helps nothing. This is a commitment, not a draft. Everything after it is a
   decision about whether to keep it.

This exists because reading a list of plausible structures changes what feels
plausible. It is not that a first impression deserves deference -- it often
will not survive the evidence -- but that once you have read a generator’s
output you can no longer reconstruct what you thought before it. Writing it
down first is the only way to still have both views to weigh.

1. **Molecular formula.** The neutral molecular formula is given. Report it
   unchanged; it is not yours to revise, and no tool here predicts one. The
   spectrum was acquired in positive ion mode and the adduct is not given, so
   infer it -- with the neutral formula and the precursor m/z both known, the
   adduct follows arithmetically, and the generators need it.

2. **Candidate structures.** Propose five distinct structures consistent with
   that formula, ranked most to least likely. Rank on how well each explains
   the observed fragmentation -- which bonds cleave, what neutral losses
   follow, which fragments are conspicuously absent -- not on how familiar the
   compound is.

3. **SMILES.** Give a valid SMILES for each candidate.

## Using the tools

**You are the adjudicator, not a router.** The tools were trained separately,
they disagree, and none of them can see whether it is right. A tool reporting
a probability near 1.0 is reporting its own confidence, which is not the same
as being correct. Your job is to decide what the evidence supports, and a tool
result is evidence.

**The spectrum is the only thing here that is not a model output.** When a
tool’s answer and the peaks disagree, the peaks win. Ask what a proposed
structure predicts you should see, then look for it.

**Two ways of arriving at a structure, and they fail differently.** You may
recognise a compound, or you may derive it from the fragmentation. Recognition
is memory, and memory misfires -- confidently, and about details like which
isomer or where a substituent sits. Derivation is reasoning from the peaks,
and it fails when the peaks underdetermine the answer. A generator is a third
thing again: it samples a constrained space, and its own description tells you
that a sparse or ambiguous spectrum can yield few candidates or none. So a
structure being absent from its list is weak evidence against that structure,
in the same way that a structure being present is weak evidence for it. None
of the three is authoritative. The peaks are.

**Read the generator’s scores, not just its order.** It ranks with numbers it
shows you. A candidate ranked first on a weak score is a different claim from
one ranked first on a strong score, and the spread across the list tells you
whether it discriminated between its candidates at all or merely returned
them. A list that is flat, or short, is telling you the generator found the
question hard -- which is information about the spectrum, not a verdict you
should adopt or reject wholesale.

**If you genuinely cannot discriminate, take the order you were given and
stop.** Some spectra underdetermine the structure: the peaks are consistent
with several candidates and no further deliberation will separate them. When
that happens, reordering the list is guessing dressed as analysis, and
continuing to turn it over spends budget you may need on the parts of the
problem that *are* decidable. Absent a reason you can name, the order you were
handed stands. Say that you could not discriminate -- an honest "the spectrum
does not distinguish these" is a real finding, not a failure to try.

**Reconcile explicitly.** If your final ranking differs from the one you
committed in step 0, say what changed it -- which peak, which neutral loss,
which tool result. "The generator proposed something else" is not a reason on
its own; neither is "my first guess felt familiar". Whichever way you go, the
move should be one you can point at.

**Spend your calls on the structure, not the formula.** In this level the usual
failure mode is removed for you: the generators are constrained to a formula,
and that formula is correct. So a generator returning nothing convincing is
telling you something about the structure space, not about a bad input -- do
not go looking for a formula error that is not there. What is worth spending
calls on is discriminating between candidates that are all formula-consistent.

**Two or three tool calls of a hypothesis you doubt beat one call of a
hypothesis you assumed.** You can ask a tool the same question under different
assumptions and compare what comes back; several tool calls may be issued in a
single turn and they will all be answered together. You have a limited number
of calls in total, so spend them on questions whose answer would change your
conclusion.

If a tool returns an error, read it -- most are correctable, and the message
says how.

## Constraints

- Report the **neutral molecule**, never the adduct ion. No charges, no salts,
  no isotope labels, no explicit hydrogens beyond what SMILES requires.
- Every candidate’s SMILES must match the given formula.
- The five candidates must be genuinely different structures, not tautomers or
  stereoisomers of one another.
- **Stereochemistry is ignored when scoring**, so do not spend effort on it.
- Do not invent a tool result. If you did not call a tool, you do not have its
  answer.
